base_branch_rationale: Wave E reads what waves B, C and D wrote, so it branches from wave D.

owner_start_signal.detail: The owner set the goal to implement the whole cluster plan in batch order; this record bounds Batch 3 wave A.

implementation_scope.summary: resolve_key returning at most one published record per role, scope and locale and failing closed on an ambiguous key; a published projection carrying only the published head, only public fields and only records the caller may read, with filtered records counted and never named; and a slug uniqueness guard whose scope is role, scope and locale.

forbidden_files_note: OperationDescriptor and SyncOperationRuntime are forbidden on purpose: the freeze enforces the v2 policy at registration precisely so that neither has to change.
forbidden_behavior: changing the existing schema, record or version tables in any way
returning a draft, scheduled or archived revision from a public read
returning a field whose visibility is not public from the published projection
naming a filtered record to a caller who may not read it
returning the first of several candidates for a key instead of failing closed
writing anything from a read path
adding a public HTTP, REST or MCP surface
changing larena/core, larena/access or any package other than larena/storage
touching larena.test or any live environment
push, release or deployment without a separate owner request
test_plan: Plain-PHP package tests in the existing storage style with an in-memory SQLite capsule mirroring the frozen shapes.
required_tests: resolve_key returns the published record for a role, scope and locale and nothing for an unpublished one
two candidates for the same key fail closed with ambiguous_key rather than returning the first
a miss is indistinguishable from a record the caller may not read
the projection carries only the published head and excludes draft, scheduled and archived revisions
the projection excludes every field whose visibility is not public
a scope-filtered record is reported as a count and never as an identifier
slug uniqueness holds per role, scope and locale and a conflicting value is refused
the same slug is allowed in another scope and in another locale
a role-bound site_node tree with localized values renders in two locales from one record set
smoke_plan: resolve_key and the published projection against the root on sqlite and mysql, with a two-locale site tree rendered from one record set and read back after a restart.

action_gate_summary.note: Re-run the action gate inside the core package repository at coding start.

stop_conditions: a frozen table shape, identity grammar, state set or reason code would have to change
an existing schema, record or version table would have to change
the workbench would have to change
a recursive CTE or a MySQL 8 only feature would be required
a file outside the allowed boundary would have to change
an unrecorded product or architecture decision is required
the storage package repository is dirty or not initialized
nonclaims: A launch record authorizes a bounded coding wave; it does not authorize push, release or deployment.
Wave E ships read contracts as PHP contracts and operations. The REST endpoints that consume them are a later batch.
A headless read is proven through the contracts, not through a route.

amendments.reason: the lifecycle contract gains dueSchedules() as a read so the sweep proposal is a genuine dry run; the revision-existence check is an injected callable bound by the composed application
